title: Learn English with Anano
subtitle: Interactive lessons for kids and teenagers
aboutText: Hello! I'm Anano, a passionate English tutor who loves working with children and teens. My lessons are fun, effective, and tailored to each student's needs.
testimonial1: Anano's lessons are fun and easy to follow. My kid really enjoys learning! – Nino, Parent
testimonial2: Thanks to Anano, I started speaking English more confidently. – Giorgi, 12 y/o
